treaty_of_paris_1783.title: The Treaty of Paris
treaty_of_paris_1783.description: Recognition of American independence redraws the Atlantic balance of power. European powers weigh the cost of distant empires against domestic treasuries.

crimean_war_1853.title: The Eastern Question
crimean_war_1853.description: Clashes over holy sites and maritime straits erupt into war between European powers. Steamships, rifles and telegraphs reveal the industrial face of modern conflict.

meiji_restoration_1868.title: The Meiji Restoration
meiji_restoration_1868.description: The shogunate falls as the imperial government pursues radical modernization. Feudal domains yield to industrialization, rail networks and universal conscription.

berlin_conference_1884.title: The Berlin Conference
berlin_conference_1884.description: European chancelleries divide an entire continent into spheres of influence and protectorates. Effective occupation replaces historical exploration as title to land.

treaty_of_versailles_1919.title: The Peace of Versailles
treaty_of_versailles_1919.description: The Great War ends in a compromise of collective security, territorial partitions and severe reparations. Old empires shatter into fragile nation-states.

bretton_woods_1944.title: The Bretton Woods Agreement
bretton_woods_1944.description: Forty-four nations gather in New Hampshire to create the post-war financial order. Pegged exchange rates, the IMF and the World Bank promise currency stability.

bandung_conference_1955.title: The Bandung Conference
bandung_conference_1955.description: Twenty-nine Asian and African nations proclaim the Non-Aligned Movement, refusing to become pawns in Cold War bloc rivalry while defending anticolonial sovereignty.

cuban_missile_crisis_1962.title: The Brink of Annihilation
cuban_missile_crisis_1962.description: Strategic missiles in the Caribbean bring the superpowers face to face with nuclear exchange. Navies blockade, air forces scramble, and diplomacy races the clock.

nixon_shock_1971.title: The Gold Window Closes
nixon_shock_1971.description: Unilateral suspension of dollar-gold convertibility brings an end to Bretton Woods fixed parities. The world enters the era of floating fiat currencies.

dotcom_and_digital_2000.title: The Digital Frontier
dotcom_and_digital_2000.description: Global fiber networks and personal computers transform telecommunications and capital markets. Speculative valuations collide with real technological leaps.

arab_spring_2011.title: The Arab Spring
arab_spring_2011.description: Mass protests, social media mobilization and food price spikes trigger sudden uprisings across North Africa and the Middle East, challenging decades of authoritarian rule.

supply_chain_nearshoring_2021.title: Strategic Reshoring
supply_chain_nearshoring_2021.description: Pandemic bottlenecks, transport costs and geopolitical tension push governments toward semiconductor subsidies, critical mineral alliances and domestic friend-shoring.

loitering_munitions_maturity_2027.title: The Munitions That Wait
loitering_munitions_maturity_2027.description: Cheap loitering airframes, produced by the hundred thousand, make every supply road and every march a watched thing. Armies relearn dispersion; staffs relearn patience.

counter_uas_wall_2028.title: The Counter-Drone Wall
counter_uas_wall_2028.description: Radar masts, laser mounts and jamming trucks grow along every front. The cheap sky meets its answer, and the answer costs more than the question.

rare_earth_squeeze_2029.title: The Rare Earth Squeeze
rare_earth_squeeze_2029.description: Export quotas and refinery politics double the price of what every motor, missile and turbine needs. The world industrial policy era begins in a mine.

orbital_broadband_2030.title: Orbital Broadband
orbital_broadband_2030.description: Mega-constellations finish stitching the planet: the last valleys without a signal come online, and the first orbital economies with them.

solid_state_batteries_2031.title: The Solid State Decade
solid_state_batteries_2031.description: Batteries that do not burn and charge in minutes rebuild the car, the grid and the march. Autonomy is no longer a demonstration.

demographic_winter_2033.title: The Demographic Winter
demographic_winter_2033.description: Birthrooms stay empty in half the world's economies. Pension arithmetic turns from dull to cruel, and every government discovers it is now an immigration ministry.

ai_governance_referendum_2034.title: The Machine in the Ministry
ai_governance_referendum_2034.description: A national referendum on letting language models draft regulation passes narrowly, fails loudly elsewhere, and either way ends the argument about whether the question exists.

arctic_routes_2036.title: The Arctic Opens
arctic_routes_2036.description: Late-summer passages stay clear long enough to insure. Cargo moves over the top; the ports that were outposts become addresses.

lunar_industrialisation_2039.title: The Lunar Yard
lunar_industrialisation_2039.description: The first industrial extraction on another world: a rounding error of GDP and a round number of everything else.

grey_fleet_decarbonisation_2042.title: The Fleets Go Quiet
grey_fleet_decarbonisation_2042.description: The last national naval orders for oil-fired hulls are signed, and the shipyards learn a new trade. The sea lanes change their arithmetic slowly, then all at once.

warning_satellite_scare_2032.title: The Ninety-Second Shadow
warning_satellite_scare_2032.description: A warning satellite dies in a debris cloud and, for ninety seconds, a duty officer's screen shows launch. It is a flock of geese, an aging sensor, a badly timed exercise. Nobody fires. Nobody forgets either.

the_black_suitcase_2035.title: The Black Suitcase Minutes
the_black_suitcase_2035.description: A coup-shaken capital, a general no cabinet can reach, and a launch exercise nobody told the neighbours about. The phones work. That is the whole of what prevents the end of the world.

second_caribbean_moment_2038.title: The Second Caribbean Moment
second_caribbean_moment_2038.description: Missiles on a neighbour's soil again, a blockade again, and both fleets' submarines holding station off the same shallow sea. Thirteen days of freighted silence, ended by a back channel both sides later deny.

red_line_treaty_2041.title: The Red Line Treaty
red_line_treaty_2041.description: Every hand that could end the world signs one document: hotlines that never close, exercises announced a month ahead, satellites nobody shoots at. It is not peace. It is the world agreeing to keep flinching in slow motion.
